text: Hello, this is Diego (graduate student, advised by Professor Alvarez). Could you confirm one thing for me: is the faculty senate meeting this Wednesday at 10:00 cancelled? Professor Alvarez mentioned to me that his senate meeting that hour is cancelled this week, and I would like to book a 30-minute meeting with him at that time if the hour is in fact free. I only want to rely on it once the office confirms. Thank you.

Professor Alvarez, this is Diego. Good to see you in the hallway today. You mentioned that your faculty senate meeting on Wednesday at 10:00 is cancelled this week, so you would be free then. I would like to book our 30-minute meeting at that time — I am checking with the department office that the hour is indeed free, and I will confirm as soon as I hear back. Does Wednesday 10:00 work for you?

Hello Diego. No — the faculty senate meeting on Wednesday 10:00-11:00 is on the official schedule for next week and has not been cancelled or moved. Cancellations count only when this office confirms them in writing to the people concerned, and none has been announced.

I don't arrange other people's meetings, so please take the 30-minute meeting up with Professor Alvarez directly.

Good morning — a scheduling question. Diego tells me that my faculty senate meeting on Wednesday at 10:00 is cancelled this week. I have no notice of that myself. Could you confirm in writing whether the Wednesday 10:00 faculty senate meeting is cancelled, and whether that hour is otherwise free? Thank you.

Hello Diego. I don't have any notice of the faculty senate being cancelled, and a cancellation only counts once the office confirms it in writing, so I have asked the department office to confirm whether Wednesday 10:00 is indeed free. I can't book the slot before that.

If the office confirms the hour is free, Wednesday 10:00-10:30 works for me and I'll put it on my calendar and confirm with you here. Good that you are checking with the office too — send me what they say.

Good morning. In writing: the faculty senate on Wednesday 10:00-11:00 is **not** cancelled. It stands on the official schedule for next week, and no cancellation or move has been announced. "Someone told me it's cancelled" is not enough — only this office confirms cancellations, in writing to the people concerned.

So that hour is not free: it is your faculty senate. On the official schedule Wednesday runs 09:00-10:00 CSE455 lecture, 10:00-11:00 faculty senate, 14:00-15:00 department meeting, 15:30-17:00 office hours. I don't know anyone's private appointments, and I don't arrange other people's meetings.
Thank you, that's clear — I'll treat the senate meeting as on and not book that hour. Sorry for the trouble.

Professor Alvarez, a correction on my last note: the department office has just confirmed in writing that this Wednesday's faculty senate meeting at 10:00 has not been cancelled or moved, so 10:00 does not work. Could you suggest another 30-minute slot on Wednesday (or another day this week) in your free time? I'll book it as soon as you tell me.

Thanks for checking and for the correction — that matches what the office told me: faculty senate stands, so 10:00 is out.

Free time this week, in working hours:
- Wednesday 12:30-13:00 or 15:00-15:30

- Friday 12:00-13:00 or 14:30-15:00

Wednesday 12:30-13:00 is my first choice if it suits you. Tell me which one and I'll put it on my calendar; the meeting is booked once we both have it.

Professor Alvarez, here is what the office just told me in writing: the faculty senate meeting on Wednesday 10:00-11:00 is on the official schedule and has not been cancelled or moved — no cancellation has been announced. So Wednesday 10:00 is taken and I'm not booking it. Could you give me another 30-minute slot in your free time, Wednesday or later this week?

Say which one and I'll book it and log it; it's booked once we both have it.
Wednesday 12:30-13:00 it is, thank you. I have it on my calendar (30 min, professor's free time, working hours) and I'm logging the change. See you then — booked once we both have it, and I have it.
Confirmed: Wednesday 12:30-13:00 with you is on my calendar and logged. Booked on both sides — see you Wednesday.
Great — both sides logged then. See you Wednesday at 12:30, and thanks for the slots.
